entities.name: Paging Procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed only in 3GPP access used by the network to request establishment of NAS signalling connection, re-establish user-plane resources for PDU sessions, and initiate mobile terminating SMS.

entities.name: eDRX Cycle
entities.description: Extended Discontinuous Reception cycle length parameter used for paging timing.

entities.name: Paging Time Window
entities.description: Time window during which paging can occur for UEs using eDRX.

entities.name: Negotiated extended DRX parameters IE
entities.description: Information element containing eDRX parameters negotiated during registration.

entities.name: Voice Service Indication
entities.description: Indication included in paging message when pending data is related to voice service.

entities.name: Paging Restriction Information
entities.description: Stored information used by network to decide whether to initiate paging procedure.

entities.name: T time
entities.description: Short time period used for paging initiation ahead of next paging time window.

relations.description: Paging procedure timing is governed by eDRX cycle parameters.
Paging procedure initiation depends on paging time window timing.
Paging procedure uses parameters from Negotiated extended DRX parameters IE.
Paging procedure may include Voice Service Indication in paging message.
Paging procedure initiation decision considers stored paging restriction information.
Paging procedure may be initiated T time ahead of next paging time window.
